committee: * Presentation of Resolution No. 179-38 (COR) -Senator Tina Rose Muña-Barnes
title: Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Please join me in presenting Resolution No. 179-38 (COR), “ Relative to recognizing Joseph “Joe” Tedpahogo Chargualaf for his dedicated service to the Parish Community of San Isidro Catholic Church in Malojloj , Inalahan ; and congratulating him for being selected as the 2026 Grand Marshal of this year’s Fiestan San Isidro .” Presentation will be held today, May 15, 2026 at 7:30 PM at the Malojloj Stage, Church Grounds. 5.15.26 10:45am (FN)
